propositions: Agent-driven development loop lacks an aggregation layer to derive trends over time from durable event-sourced history (tickets, gate sidecars, module-size ratchet, git)

Three tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)

Bug-close transition requires a free-text --reason argument that is validated then discarded; replace with a bounded --class enum persisted on STATUS event without increasing friction (swap one required arg, do not add)

Auto-derive caused_by link edges from git blame over pre-fix state (parent of fixing commit) when a bug has recorded file_impact; skip derivation when ambiguous and always allow explicit --caused-by override; backfilled edges bypass closed-source guards (555e direct write)
Snapshot series must be committed to git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (not gitignored reports/) so metrics persist across synced history

Every registered metric in rebar metrics output carries source and confidence; backfilled/classified values never aggregate into authoritative structural series; unavailable metrics report structured reason + accruing_since
